query:
SELECT cs.state_key as "user_id!", e.content as "content!: Json<serde_json::Value>"
               FROM current_state cs
               JOIN event e ON cs.event_rowid = e.rowid
               WHERE cs.room_id = $1
                 AND cs.user_id = $2
                 AND cs.event_type = 'm.room.member'
                 AND cs.state_key = ANY($3)
